summary:
Ukraine struck the Kerch bridge linking Russia with occupied Crimea for a second straight day on Tuesday, critically damaging it. President Volodymyr Zelensky called the attack unprecedented and said it was retaliation for Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure. The Kremlin said the bridge would be restored and would be 'better than ever'; on the same day Russia hit two major bridges in Kyiv.

US President Donald Trump landed in Manila on Monday to begin a 48-hour Asia trip, starting with a Quad leaders' meeting, the grouping's first summit since 2024. The Quad expressed 'grave concerns' about economic coercion, including arbitrary export restrictions. Trump later travels to Shenzhen, China, to meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, and says he will discuss Ukraine, contrary to an earlier White House announcement. In Manila he is also due to sign a trade deal under which Thailand will drop US tariffs and buy $2.6 billion of US agricultural products.

US Central Command said on Monday that a third American aircraft carrier had arrived in the Middle East, as Iran targets Bahrain. President Trump has said the war 'militarily is effectively over' while also threatening strikes on Iran.

headlines.title: Ukraine critically damages Kerch bridge linking Russia and Crimea
headlines.summary: Ukraine struck the bridge for a second straight day on Tuesday, and Zelensky called the attack 'unprecedented' and retaliation for Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure. The Kremlin said the bridge would be restored and be 'better than ever', while Russia hit two major bridges in Kyiv.

headlines.title: Trump begins Asia trip with Quad summit in Manila
headlines.summary: Trump arrived in Manila on Monday for a 48-hour trip, and the Quad expressed 'grave concerns' about economic coercion at its first summit since 2024. He is due to meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China, later in the trip.

headlines.title: Third US aircraft carrier arrives in Middle East
headlines.summary: US Central Command said on Monday that a third American carrier had arrived in the Middle East as Iran targets Bahrain. President Trump has said the war 'militarily is effectively over' while threatening strikes on Iran.

headlines.title: Canada and China agree to ease tariffs
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney and President Xi Jinping agreed on broader trade concessions, and Canada said it will further reduce tariffs on a range of products. The deal comes as Ottawa seeks to reset relations with Beijing amid trade tensions with the United States.

headlines.title: Five EU countries revive plan to send migrants to Rwanda
headlines.summary: Germany and four other EU states plan to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda, which would receive migrants while they explore return or settlement options. Human rights groups have criticised the plans, warning of potential abuses.

headlines.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police over wages
headlines.summary: Police fired tear gas, stun grenades and batons at thousands of garment workers who blocked highways out of Dhaka after a wage board meeting was postponed. Protesters hurled bricks and torched vehicles.

headlines.title: Deutsche Bank shares fall after leak of client records
headlines.summary: Deutsche Bank shares fell on Tuesday after media outlets published reports on the bank's ties to Russian oligarchs, Jeffrey Epstein and Donald Trump. In leaked records, an analyst wrote: 'As you know we have a large Russian Oligarchs client population.'
